'''Bomb disposal experts''' or '''explosives disposal officers''' were [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force's]] [[ordnance disposal]] unit who were trained to disable [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] and other explosives.

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], several bomb disposal officers were present at the [[Galactic City spaceport hostage siege]]. They disabled the bombs that had been used to hold several hostages after the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] were neutralized by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Omega Squad]].
